title: The whistle cord
logline: The whistle's cord, close, hanging from the ceiling by the boiler, a wooden handle on its end worn pale by fifty years of hands. Nobody pulling it. The page before the sound.

panels.composition: Close on a braided cord hanging from a mill's ceiling by a boiler with a wooden handle on its end worn pale, pipes, black spotting in the dark above.
